title: Rare Bloom Special Episode - COPICafe
description:
Join us for our Rare Bloom episode - Lots of special guests and plenty of leaks.

Rob & Josh have several special guests on with them it this Leak filled episode.  Farid of Dapp Central & Pritesh of Kaizen Crypto share their impressions of the last couple weeks of Conventions. Adam Dean of Buffy Bot  and cFNTcon joins to provide his special insights of the Community Led Cardano Convention circuit.  Then Andrew  and Ryan of Newm join in to share what is coming with Newm and Cornucopias.

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
